name: Maeve Hamm
life: “I can tell the lower fountain pump from the upper by the gulls it frightens.” Monday often includes a stop at Juniper Street, where Maeve knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I heard the fountain through that gap. I've lived beside it for years and never knew it had two rhythms.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a washed violet jersey and a folded shopping list secured by a miniature clip. Maeve has fine brows over wide-set eyes, with close-cropped dark curls. Maeve counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices during a conversation.
personality: Maeve has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To let the pupils hear both fountain rhythms.
family: Adrian Dias is Maeve’s cousin raised in the same household. Maeve makes room at the table. Adrian brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *A borrowed name*, Adrian says, “I hate the fictional nickname. I brought the author the one the children actually gave me.”
connections: Wesley Carr. Signing in the pause makes room for a listener who heard the fountain underneath it.
